	query: 'Exec [CENSUS].[prGetBHMembers] @GRGR_CK=?, @HEDIS_MY=?,@PLAN=? 	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource

		{Copy of TOTDAYS} = TOTDAYS,
		{Copy of County} = County,
		{Copy of Prob_score} = Prob_score,

		{Copy of RxAdh} = RxAdh,
		{Copy of Ref_id} = Ref_id,

		{Copy of SBSB_MCTR_VIP_DESC} = SBSB_MCTR_VIP_DESC,
